entities.name: Missionário José Olímpio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Olímpio Silveira Moraes often referred to as José Olimpio or Missionário José Olimpio is a Brazilian politician, businessman, and pastor from São Paulo, having served as city councilmen and state representative. He is also a senior leader of the Igreja Mundial do Poder de Deus.

entities.summary: José Olímpio Silveira Moraes often referred to as José Olimpio or Missionário José Olimpio is a Brazilian politician, businessman, and pastor from São Paulo, having served as city councilmen and state representative. He is also a senior leader of the Igreja Mundial do Poder de Deus.
